purpose: Establish and harden the source-custody baseline for the dedicated $TRUMP empirical reconstruction without yet asserting manipulation, motive, insider activity, or quid pro quo.

observations.official_product_claim: The site identifies the product as the only official Trump meme and as a product associated with President Donald J. Trump.
observations.affiliate_ownership_statement: CIC Digital LLC, an affiliate of The Trump Organization, and Fight Fight Fight LLC collectively own 80% of the Trump Cards, subject to a 3-year unlocking schedule.
observations.trading_revenue_statement: The site states that CIC Digital LLC and Celebration Cards LLC, the owner of Fight Fight Fight LLC, receive trading revenue derived from trading activities of Trump Meme Cards.
observations.purchase_path_statement: The official site directs buyers to acquire SOL and use Raydium to swap for $TRUMP; it also references Moonshot and Solana/USDC purchase paths.
observations.investment_disclaimer: The site states that Trump Memes are expressions of support/engagement and are not intended as an investment opportunity, investment contract, or security.

observations.custody_limit: The token summary identifies creator/authority metadata and first-mint time, but this record does not yet preserve the underlying mint-creation transaction signature or full transaction instruction trace.

launch_promotion_source.source_type: archived Truth Social original-post record with original platform URL preserved
launch_promotion_source.observed_content_summary: Donald Trump announced his new official Trump meme, told readers to join his Trump community, directed them to get $TRUMP, and linked gettrumpmemes.com.
cross_source_confirmation: Trump's Truth archive preserves the original status ID and 9:00 PM EST display time.

The American Presidency Project separately preserves the same original status ID and text in its January 17, 2025 Truth Social record; its displayed clock convention differs, so the exact machine timestamp still requires platform/API or signed archive custody.
launch_promotion_source.correction_note: The prior custody draft used status ID 113868898660221095, which is a later re-Truth of the original launch post. This revision corrects the launch object to original status ID 113846888132979151.
launch_promotion_source.custody_note: The original Truth Social URL resolves but requires JavaScript in the current retrieval environment. The original status ID, URL, and independent archival corroboration are preserved; exact platform-origin machine timestamp remains not fully custodied.

independent_timing_lead.claim: The earliest TRUMP liquidity pool was deployed on January 17, 2025 at approximately 10:15 PM Eastern Time, with initial fully diluted valuation slightly above $700,000.

initial_liquidity_leads.important_discrepancy: The official product purchase instructions currently emphasize Raydium, while Reuters' blockchain-analysis reporting states the creators' initial trading and major early fee generation occurred on Meteora. The empirical reconstruction must not infer initial venue from current purchase instructions.

observations.creator_wallet_origin_description: Reuters reports Merkle Science found the three earliest holder wallets received tokens directly from creators without purchasing them, and Chainalysis assessed the three addresses belong to creators of $TRUMP.
observations.venue_description: Reuters reports the wallets began trading on Meteora and creators received a share of trading fees for liquidity provision.
observations.retail_loss_observation: Chainalysis reported about 200,000 wallets, mostly with small holdings, lost money on $TRUMP on the exchange while at least fifty of the largest investors made profits above $10 million each.
observations.custody_limit: These are independently reported blockchain-analysis estimates. ERL has not yet reproduced the three wallet addresses, fee calculations, or profit/loss population from raw chain data.

observations.method_limit: Reuters explicitly used assumptions where ownership/revenue percentages were not public; these values are methodology leads, not ERL-reproduced findings.

network_spillover_leads.source: The Block Data & Insights / Research, January 2025

observations.interpretation_boundary: These figures establish a candidate network-spillover response to the launch, not proof that every observed SOL or Solana-volume move was caused solely by $TRUMP.

independent_reporting_leads.use: creator-wallet, Meteora-liquidity, fee-estimate and participant-profit/loss leads for on-chain reproduction
transparent methodology lead for first-half token sales and estimated Trump Organization economic entitlement
earliest-liquidity-pool timing and launch valuation lead requiring transaction-level confirmation
Solana-network spillover, main-pool volume and crypto-app adoption leads

hypothesis_relevant_observations_without: The official structure directly links trading activity to revenue for identified affiliated entities, so trading volume is an economically relevant dependent variable even if token price later falls.
Independent blockchain analyses reported very large fee generation within the first two weeks, making turnover/fee capture empirically more important than price-only analysis.

The reported three creator wallets create a bounded wallet-attribution target that can be reproduced from the initial 200 million-token distribution rather than beginning with an unconstrained wallet search.

The current official purchase path includes SOL/Raydium, but secondary on-chain reporting places initial trading and the dominant early fee mechanism on Meteora; venue chronology must therefore be reconstructed rather than assumed.
The launch coincided with large SOL and Solana-DEX activity changes, creating a measurable network-spillover control for later WLF/asset-adoption analyses.
The concentrated affiliate allocation and three-year unlock schedule make inventory value, unlock timing, liquidity management, token sales, and fees separate beneficiary channels.
None of these structural facts or reported estimates establishes manipulation, improper intent, insider activity, or unlawful conduct.
